notes: Migrated from a full standalone profiles/mobileye.json to a thin record on 2026-08-13. The resolved document is byte-identical in every field the fetchers read - asserted by tests/test_platform_profiles.py, which pins the resolved endpoint, field map and detail_fetch rather than trusting the migration. THE EU HOST MATTERS and is why api.endpoint is overridden here: api.lever.co (non-EU) 404s for this slug, and mobileye is the only EU-hosted account of the 8 live Lever companies. detail_fetch now comes from the lever platform profile, where it was moved because it is platform behaviour - it was originally verified against this company's posting, which is still the URL recorded there.
